ModMetaData.name: MSE Droid North Fix — Outer Rim: Droid Depot
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the missing north-facing art of the MSE-6 repair droid in Outer Rim - Droid Depot.
The droid's PawnKindDef declares Graphic_Multi, which means RimWorld expects four directions, but the mod only ever shipped two: south and east. When a direction is absent Graphic_Multi silently falls back to the south texture, so an MSE droid walking AWAY from you turns around and shows you its FRONT. Nothing is logged — "Failed to find any textures at" fires only when every direction of a set is missing, and this set has two.
No defs are patched, no code runs, and Outer Rim - Droid Depot is not altered. This mod drops one loose PNG at the path the donor's own def already asks for.
CONTENTS
OuterRim/Droid/MSE_north The back of the MSE-6 repair droid. 256x256, 1,051 bytes, 8.86% of the canvas inked.
THE DONOR'S ORIGINAL: there is none. Droid Depot ships MSE_south (256x256, 2,707 bytes) and MSE_east (256x256, 2,064 bytes) and no north texture at any load folder. The absence was confirmed against the 1.6 AssetBundle rather than against the mod's stale loose folder: the bundle manifest lists DroidDepot/Textures/OuterRim/Droid/MSE_east and DroidDepot/Textures/OuterRim/Droid/MSE_south and no MSE_north entry, so there is nothing to override and nothing to conflict with.
HOW OURS WAS BUILT AND VERIFIED: the silhouette and the black keyline are copied PIXEL-FOR-PIXEL from the donor's own MSE_south, so registration, canvas, bounding box (97, 80, 159, 178) and 3 px keyline weight are exact by construction and cannot drift. Only the interior is re-authored — the front bevel is replaced by a plain rear panel with a horizontal vent seam and two vertical panel joints, using the donor's own measured greys (upper plate 231, lower panel 178, seam shadows 148), which is what the back of a box droid should read as. The generator is shipped in Source/draw_mse_north.py.
WHERE THE DEF IS
Outer Rim - Droid Depot's own PawnKindDef asks for a four-way graphic:
1.6/Defs/ThingDefs_Automatons/Animal/Droid_MSEDroid.xml line 81 defName OuterRim_MSEDroid line 89 texPath OuterRim/Droid/MSE line 90 graphicClass Graphic_Multi line 113 recipeIcon OuterRim/Droid/MSE_south
NO LOAD ORDER REQUIREMENT — AND THAT IS DELIBERATE
This mod deliberately declares no loadAfter, because it does not need one.
On 1.6 Outer Rim - Droid Depot serves its art from an AssetBundle, not from loose files. Its LoadFolders.xml swaps the v1.4/v1.5 "Common_Old" folder for "Common" under v1.6, and Common/ holds nothing but AssetBundles/neronix17_outerrim_droiddepot. The loose droid PNGs still sitting in Common_Old are not loaded on this game version.
RimWorld resolves a texture as loose file in any active mod FIRST, then base game resources, then AssetBundles — so a loose PNG beats a bundled asset regardless of which mod loads first. In this particular case the point is academic twice over, since the bundle contains no north texture to be beaten.
If Outer Rim - Droid Depot ever ships its own MSE_north, this mod would still win by being loose, so unsubscribe it at that point.
